30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_230_001

67.description: The information contained in this log may prove useful in preparing for your next exploratory voyage.

69.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_360_000

81.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_002
81.description: In order to embark upon an exploratory mission, you and your party must meet the following requirements:

82.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_011
82.description: All party members must have completed the main scenario quest “Heavensward.”

83.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_012
83.description: All party members must be level 60 Disciples of War or Magic.

84.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_003
84.description: Furthermore, all party members must be in possession of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>mission ceruleum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which may be purchased from resident caretakers or the mammet voyager #004A.

85.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_004
85.description: It is possible to participate in missions by forming parties consisting of two or more members.

86.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_005
86.description: If you wish to embark upon a mission with less than eight players, you may do so via the voyage control panel. However, please be advised that you will be unable to add new members during the mission.

87.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_013
87.description: Please also be aware that Disciples of War or Magic higher than level 60 will be automatically level synced upon entry.

88.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_006
88.description: Exploratory missions are subject to a time limit, and you will earn a reward by completing mission objectives within the time given.

89.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_510_005
89.description: Successfully completing a mission also earns you the ability to manipulate aetherial gaps, allowing you to pass beyond the Grounding Gale.

90.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_510_006
90.description: Furthermore, please be advised that you will not be permitted to change to a Disciple of the Land or Hand while on a Trials of the Fury exploratory mission.

91.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_007
91.description: All items in a player's loot list will automatically be transferred to that player's inventory upon all other party members leaving the area.

92.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_008
92.description: Items unable to be obtained will be lost.

93.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_009
93.description: Please note that once you have participated in an exploratory mission, you may not do so again for 30 minutes (Earth time).

94.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_010
94.description: Moreover, the airship which you used to embark upon your mission may not be deployed on missions or voyages for 5 minutes (Earth time).

138.description: Upon the completion of a subaquatic voyage, your mammet will provide a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> detailing the results.
